decisions.topic: Recorded completion does not prove durability during read-only reconciliation
decisions.decision: A validated completion graph may retain its AS_RECORDED state label, but the read-only reconciliation result must explicitly report durability_state UNKNOWN and evidence_finalized false. It grants neither fresh success nor approval.
decisions.basis: Independent reviewer cited accepted P07 design uncertainty clauses: marker presence cannot distinguish successful parent-directory fsync from a lost/failed final fsync. No admitted independent proof exists in this API.
constraints: No extra fsync, write, retry or launch in reconciliation.
Caller-log append content does not supply approval or durability proof.
Exercise final-marker directory-fsync failure followed by read-only reconciliation.
Keep positive historical start counts and recorded graph observations separate from unresolved durability.
